title: The Classified 'Alien Observatory' That Watches Us From the Moon
hook: A structure on the far side of the Moon is transmitting signals that match no known technology—and it's been active since before Apollo.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines government secrecy, lunar mystery, and potential extraterrestrial presence—triggers deep distrust and curiosity.

title: The Signal That Repeated Every 16 Days—Until It Stopped Forever
hook: For four years, a radio burst pulsed like clockwork from a dead galaxy—then one day it went silent, and no one knows why.
why_this_can_go_viral: Pattern + sudden silence creates a mystery that feels intentional—viewers will speculate about alien civilization death.

title: The 'Gamma Ray Garden'—A Region of Space Where Stars Are Murdered
hook: A 500-light-year-wide zone in the galaxy has zero stars—because something is systematically destroying every sun that enters.
why_this_can_go_viral: Personification of space as a killer and the idea of a 'murder zone' is highly shareable and eerie.

title: The Asteroid That Will Hit Earth—And We Know the Exact Street
hook: Astronomers have tracked an asteroid whose impact path narrows to a single neighborhood in 2053—but no government has told the residents.
why_this_can_go_viral: Extreme specificity (a street!) plus government secrecy—creates paranoia and urgent shareability.

title: The 'Fermi Paradox Filter' That We Already Failed 50 Years Ago
hook: A signal sent from Earth in 1974 may have already marked us for extinction—and the reply window is closing.
why_this_can_go_viral: Plays on the fear that humanity's own actions triggered a cosmic threat—self-inflicted doom is highly engaging.

title: The Classified 'Venus Colony'—A Secret Space Station Behind the Clouds
hook: Declassified documents suggest the USSR built a floating station in Venus's atmosphere in the 1980s—and it's still transmitting.
why_this_can_go_viral: Cold War secrecy + Venus's hellish environment + a still-active signal—triple mystery.

title: The 'Extinction Burp'—A Supernova That Already Hit Us and No One Noticed
hook: In 2019, a gamma ray pulse washed over Earth—it was just a precursor. The main blast is still traveling toward us.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea that destruction is already in transit but not yet arrived creates suspense and urgency.

title: The 'Star That Shouldn't Exist'—It's Made of Matter That Breaks Physics
hook: A star in the Milky Way is composed of elements that require a supernova to form—but it's too old for any supernova to have existed nearby.
why_this_can_go_viral: Challenges fundamental physics—people love 'science is wrong' narratives.

title: The 'Black Hole That Hides a Universe'—And We're Living Inside It
hook: Our entire cosmos may be the interior of a black hole in another universe—and the event horizon is closing in.
why_this_can_go_viral: Mind-bending scale + existential dread—perfect for cosmic niche audiences.

title: The 'Dead Civilisation's Last Signal'—A 2-Billion-Year-Old Message
hook: A repeating radio pattern from a galaxy 2 billion light-years away may be the final transmission of a species that died before Earth existed.
why_this_can_go_viral: Time-depth + extinction + message from beyond death—emotionally powerful and mysterious.

title: The 'Rogue Star' That Will Graze the Solar System—And Tear Us Apart
hook: A star is on a collision course with the Oort Cloud—it won't hit us, but its gravity will fling asteroids at Earth like bullets.
why_this_can_go_viral: Visual of a star 'grazing' the solar system is terrifying and easy to animate.

title: The 'Fermi Paradox Coffin'—Every Civilization Dies at 500 Years of Radio
hook: Statistical analysis of galactic civilizations shows they all go silent within 500 years of discovering radio—and we're at year 120.
why_this_can_go_viral: Countdown to doom—creates urgency and personal connection ('we are in danger').

title: The Classified 'Neutron Star Bomb'—A Weapon That Could Shatter Planets
hook: A declassified DARPA document describes a theoretical weapon using neutron star matter—a teaspoon of which weighs a billion tons.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines real physics with sci-fi weapon concept—fascination with forbidden technology.

title: The 'Dark Matter Tsunami'—A Wave of Invisible Death Passing Through Earth
hook: Earth is currently being hit by a dark matter 'wind' that may be altering our genetics—and it's getting stronger.
why_this_can_go_viral: Personal threat (changing your DNA) + invisible phenomenon—fear of the unknown.

title: The 'Extinction Star' That Winks at Us Every 69 Days—A Timer
hook: A star pulses every 69 days like a countdown clock—and its last pulse was slightly off, meaning the timer changed.
why_this_can_go_viral: Pattern-breaking creates mystery and fear—viewer will wonder if the timer is for Earth.

title: The 'Alien Megastructure Star'—It's Not Dyson Spheres, It's Gravestones
hook: The famous Tabby's Star dims irregularly—new analysis suggests the objects blocking its light are the ruins of a dead civilization's space cities.
why_this_can_go_viral: Twist on a famous mystery—'it's not technology, it's ruins'—adds melancholy and depth.

title: The Classified 'Mars War'—Evidence of a Nuclear Explosion on the Red Planet
hook: NASA images show a region of Mars with radioactive isotopes that can only be explained by a nuclear blast—natural or otherwise.
why_this_can_go_viral: Suggests a hidden history of violence on Mars—triggers conspiracy and mystery curiosity.

title: The 'Vacuum Void'—A Region Where Physics Doesn't Work Anymore
hook: A patch of space 1 billion light-years across has no matter, no radiation—and the laws of physics appear to break down inside it.
why_this_can_go_viral: 'Reality glitch' concept is highly memeable and shareable.

title: The 'Fermi Paradox Zoo'—Earth Is a Wildlife Preserve and the Keepers Are Watching
hook: Some physicists believe the reason we see no aliens is that we're in a protected 'zoo'—and the zookeepers have a strict no-contact policy.
why_this_can_go_viral: Feels like a sci-fi plot but with real scientific backing—triggers paranoia and speculation.

title: The 'Signal From Hell'—A Planet Where It Rains Molten Iron and It's Talking to Us
hook: A planet 400 light-years away has a surface temperature of 4,000°F—and it's emitting a repeating signal that sounds like a scream.
why_this_can_go_viral: Extreme imagery (hell planet screaming) is high-impact and shareable.

title: The 'Classified Space Tether'—A 60-Mile Cable That Was Never Explained
hook: In 1996, NASA deployed a tether in space that was 60 miles long—then it snapped and the project was classified overnight.
why_this_can_go_viral: Mystery of a giant, unexplained object in space—simple but compelling.

title: The 'Asteroid That Cried'—A Chunk of Rock That Emits a Human Voice
hook: A near-Earth asteroid emits radio waves that, when translated, produce a sound that uncannily resembles a human scream.
why_this_can_go_viral: Extremely eerie and personal—a rock that 'screams' is instantly viral material.

title: The 'Fermi Paradox Silence'—We Are the First, the Last, and the Only
hook: If the universe is empty, it means we are either the first intelligent species—or we're alone because everyone else already died.
why_this_can_go_viral: Existential dread combined with a sense of unique responsibility—high philosophical impact.
